ἀγρός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂדֶה ];
__1. a field: Mat.6:28, al.
__2. the country: Mrk.15:21, al.; pl., country places, farms: Mrk.5:14 6:36 56, Luk.8:34 9:12.
__3. = χωρίον a piece of ground: Mrk.10:29, Act.4:27, al. (On the occurrence of this word as compared with χώρα, χωρίον see MM, VGT, see word)

strongs.def: a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet
strongs.kjv: country, farm, piece of ground, land
